candidate: VOLUME_RQA_TT_OVER_LAM_RATIO_SHOCK_MR (RQA ratio TT_mean/%LAM, trapping time / mean vertical-line length normalized by laminarity, on delay-embedded log-volume returns; m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168,l_min=2; fade RATIO_TT_LAM shocks vs ALB=336)
feature_definition: RATIO_TT_LAM = TT_mean / %LAM. %LAM = (sum of vertical-line points for qualifying vertical lines l>=l_min=2, main diagonal excluded) / (offdiag recurrence sum). TT_mean = mean length of qualifying vertical lines l>=l_min=2 (main diagonal excluded). Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if %LAM<=0, no qualifying vertical lines (N==0), TT_mean undefined/non-finite, offdiag/recurrence degenerate, or undefined.
